items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown on ETR Sunday injury board.
items.why: Final Friday injury report; missed practice all week with hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles backfield to Shipley/Pierce; Hurts/Goedert elevated targets likely.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries to remaining backs; Goedert red-zone.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5 (ankle) on ETR board; Huntley expected to start.
items.why: Ankle injury from Week 4; ruled out Friday.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers still Q but volume; Likely upside if targets shift.

items.text: Stefon Diggs and Michael Pittman listed OUT; Pat Bryant OUT (later IR).
items.why: Final report; Bryant short-term IR per Rapoport.
items.implication: Commanders WRs (McLaurin Q, Deebo) and Colts/PIT targets shift; Broncos WR depth.
items.opportunity: Terry McLaurin/Deebo Samuel volume if Diggs out; Broncos WRs.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final injury report) despite ankle maintenance.
items.implication: Expected lead role vs prior Week 4 drag.

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Dallas Goedert, Chris Olave listed IN.
items.why: Full or cleared on final board; Daniels start confirmed.
items.implication: Commanders QB return; Eagles TE1 active; Saints WR1 clear.
items.opportunity: Daniels rushing/passing volume; Goedert targets with Smith/Barkley out; Olave routes.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot) QUESTIONABLE; Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara also Q.
items.why: Messy final Q list; game-time potential.
items.implication: Sunday morning actives critical; Bengals WR chaos if Chase/Higgins out; Raiders RB if Jeanty sits.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Chase Brown/Higgins/Meyers; Jeanty handcuff; McConkey if Johnston already out.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (chest) along with OT Joe Alt and S Derwin James.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey (also Q) and remaining Chargers WRs elevated routes/targets.
items.opportunity: McConkey snap/route share increase if active; Herbert checkdowns.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: Jets RB committee to backups; Braelon Allen type volume.

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report/no designation (clear); Broncos place Pat Bryant on IR, promote Lil’Jordan Humphrey; 49ers activate Mykel Williams, rule out Bosa/Juszczyk.
items.implication: Evans full go for SF; Bryant out 4+ weeks.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and Week 4 usage criticism; not on final IR.
items.why: Media/fan pressure + full-go comments; downside risk if long year fatigue.
items.implication: Strong start/DFS play; higher snap/carry share expected.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back workload vs DET.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; target-hog in favorable matchup after return from hamstring.
items.why: Volume including red zone vs weak Titans secondary.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; nickname push as 'Brown Gobbler' for target/fantasy point gobbling; Bengals injury context boosts.
items.why: Workload + soft run D; Chase/Higgins Q elevates.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury/matchup), Mark Andrews (TE17, role/usage), Cam Skattebo (RB20, efficiency/game script), Jalen Hurts (QB15, banged-up line/rough stretch vs JAX London). Also hates Tony Pollard.
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, poor efficiency/environment, injury wrinkles.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman); frustration over second-half targets noted. Still good this week.
items.why: Stacked injury + scheme/QB risks over season, not single-week.
items.implication: Monitor practice; ROS caution despite elite talent.

Primary official OUTs/ACTIVES: Johnston out, Evans clear, Bryant IR, Bosa/Juszczyk out, Mykel Williams activate. Essential status rulings.
